rule.title: Premiums paid pretax are never medical expenses

when_missing.because: Taken as no unless a preparer says so: Is this an insurance premium paid by a pretax reduction of the taxpayer's pay (a cafeteria plan), so not included in box 1 of the Form W-2?

citation.wording: You can't include insurance premiums paid by making a pretax reduction to your employee compensation because these amounts are already being excluded from your income by not being included in box 1 of your Form(s) W-2.
